about: A-MENU2 full set, mood A. Made by source/build_menu2.py; do not edit by hand. Sizes are 1x px; every file has an @2x twin.

panel-frame.note: A1. 9-slice, 48 px corners on all sides (brass brackets live in the corners). Top/bottom rails stretch along x; side rails stretch along y (their grain runs that way). Content area starts 22 px in (6 shadow + 14 rail + 2 lip).

panel-inset.note: Recessed paper well for sub-areas (tray, stat strip, found strip). 9-slice 24.

title-plaque.note: EXTRA (not in A1-A13): lacquered honey plaque for screen titles; 3-slice along x (22 px caps). Text drawn by the game in dark ink #462a16.

shelf-plank.note: Shelf the cubbies stand on; 3-slice along x. The cubby bottoms sit at y = 4.
